item.text:
The schema change is ready against the repository’s stated contracts. [schema.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-Np2aGT/workspace/schema.sql) now protects audit records from application updates, deletes, and truncation, while allowing a dedicated non-login owner to remove demo-account audits during purge. The purge checks for unhandled restrictive foreign keys before deleting data.

I verified the schema on a fresh PostgreSQL 18 container, including order completion, role isolation, arbitrary custom settings, preservation of real accounts, demo purge, and the required `P0001` diagnostic.
